test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Silver ornaments become black after some time when exposed to air because:

options.text: Silver reacts with carbon in the air to form silver carbide.
Silver reacts with sulphur in the air to form silver sulphide.
Silver reacts with nitrogen in the air to form silver nitride.
Silver reacts with hydrogen in the air to form silver hydride.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Silver reacts with sulphur in the air to form silver sulphide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Silver ornaments** become black after some time when exposed to air because** s****ilver reacts with sulphur** in** the air to form silver sulphide **(Ag₂S).
 
• Silver reacts with sulphur compounds in the air, such as** hydrogen sulphide (H₂S)**.
 
• **4Ag (polished silver) + 2H₂S + O₂ → 2Ag₂S (Tarnished silver) + 2H₂O**
 
• Corrosion is a chemical reaction that also goes by the name **"Tarnishing of Silver."**
 
• Because Silver Sulphide (Ag₂S) is black, it darkens the silver.
